description: This file contains functions related to requirement management in the TestLink project, including exporting requirements to XML, importing requirements from CSV and XML formats, comparing imported requirements, and replacing requirement links in text.

methods.name: exportReqDataToXML
methods.description: Exports requirement data to XML format using a template.

methods.name: executeImportedReqs
methods.description: Processes imported requirement data, handling conflicts and creating or updating requirements.

methods.name: compareImportedReqs
methods.description: Compares imported requirements with existing ones to identify conflicts or duplicates.

methods.name: getReqDocIDs
methods.description: Retrieves requirement document IDs for a given requirement specification.

methods.name: loadImportedReq
methods.description: Loads and parses requirement data from CSV or XML files.

methods.name: importReqDataFromCSV
methods.description: Imports requirement data from a CSV file.

methods.name: importReqDataFromCSVDoors
methods.description: Imports requirement data from a CSV file specific to object/door data.

methods.name: importReqDataFromDocBook
methods.description: Imports requirement data from a DocBook XML file.

methods.name: doReqImport
methods.description: Main function to import requirements from a file, handling different formats and conflict resolution.

methods.name: exportReqDataToCSV
methods.description: Exports requirement data to CSV format.

methods.name: getReqCoverage
methods.description: Calculates coverage of requirements based on test cases and execution status.

methods.name: getLastExecutions
methods.description: Retrieves the last execution results for a set of test cases.

methods.name: check_syntax
methods.description: Checks the syntax of a requirement import file based on its type.

methods.name: check_syntax_xml
methods.description: Checks the syntax of an XML file (stub implementation).

methods.name: check_syntax_csv
methods.description: Checks the syntax of a CSV file (stub implementation).

methods.name: check_syntax_csv_doors
methods.description: Checks the syntax of a doors CSV file (stub implementation).

methods.name: req_link_replace
methods.description: Replaces BBCode-style requirement links in text with actual hyperlinks, supporting different link targets and project contexts.
